description: This file defines an Android Activity class for a Tic-Tac-Toe game. It manages the user interface components, handles user interactions such as cell clicks and game resets, and updates the UI based on game state changes.

classes.name: MainActivity
classes.description: Android Activity handling the UI and game logic for a simple Tic-Tac-Toe game.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets up UI components and click behaviors.

methods.name: updatePlayerIndicator
methods.description: Updates the display to show the current player.

methods.name: resetBoardUi
methods.description: Resets the game board and UI elements to their initial state.
